prompt: An emergency room scene. A patient is lying on a stretcher. A doctor stands at the foot of the stretcher, facing the patient. Next to the stretcher is a heart monitor with its screen facing the doctor. A nurse stands beside an IV drip stand, adjusting the drip. The doctor is taller than the nurse. The IV drip stand is taller than the doctor. On a tray on the IV drip stand are three bags of saline solution. The nurse places some syringes on the same tray, and the number of syringes is one more than the number of saline bags. A defibrillator is mounted on a wall behind the doctor. Through a window to the left, an ambulance is parked outside.
